title: The canonical structure-sheaf map for tensor pullback
statement: Let $g:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Use the tensor-formula module pullback $g^*$ and pushforward $g_*$, with their canonical adjunction $g^*\dashv g_*$ [def-pc-module-pullback], and regard the structure sheaves as modules over themselves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Define $\epsilon_g:g^*\mathcal O_Y\to\mathcal O_X$ to be the morphism adjoint to the structure-sheaf morphism $g^\sharp:\mathcal O_Y\to g_*\mathcal O_X$. Explicitly, $\epsilon_g$ is the inverse of the canonical Hom adjunction bijection applied to $g^\sharp$. This defines only the canonical morphism; its isomorphism property is a separate theorem.
